thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired for service=redwood-inference-prod severity=high — alert: elevated 5xx rate on inference API (region=us-west-2). pd-incident-id=PD-94217 :rotating_light:

jamie (eng-oncall): acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it, looking at traces now.

tess (eng-sre): thanks — I'm pulling up dashboards. Do we know which model/route is impacted?

jamie (eng-oncall): early signal shows spikes on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings for model=redwood-alpha-13b, traffic mostly from customer-tier=hosted. 5xx rate jumped from 0.1% -> ~11% in last 3m. p95 latency for embeddings went 1.2s -> 14s.

noah (infra): seeing increased queue_length on inference-workers-usw2-*. GPU mem pressure looks normal, but queue backlog is the issue. Some workers reporting `RequestTimeout` from the model process.

pagerduty-bot: PD-94217 acknowledged by jamie (eng-oncall). Escalation level: oncall -> eng-sre.

jamie (eng-oncall): quick mitigation plan: 1) scale replicas in us-west-2 2) shift a subset of traffic to fallback smaller model 3) enable immediate cache-only responses for repeated prefixes where safe. I'll run the scale first.

tess (eng-sre): +1. Also let's pin rate limit for hosted anonymous callers to reduce noise while we stabilize. Can someone run the scale command?

noah (infra): running: `kubectl scale deploy inference-worker-usw2 --replicas=12 -n prod` — watching rollout.

jamie (eng-oncall): applying temporary route override to send 30% of embeddings traffic to `redwood-alpha-8b` fallback. Command: `/ops route set-weight embeddings us-west-2 redwood-alpha-13b=70 redwood-alpha-8b=30`

sara (support): heads-up: customer-reqs flagged a 30m spike in failures — CS is preparing a short notification for impacted hosted customers. ETA 10m.

tess (eng-sre): dashboard update: 5xx rate falling to ~6% since scaling started, p95 latency down to 4.8s. Work queues still elevated but draining. Good sign.

jamie (eng-oncall): Confirming: no recent deploys to inference runtime in the last 24h. Suspect traffic burst + batching behavior hitting queue limits. Will toggle batch-size ceiling if needed.

noah (infra): I can temporarily reduce max-batch-size on the 13b workers to force faster processing: `redispatch config set max_batch_size 13b 8` — rolling that out now (5 nodes at a time).

tess (eng-sre): FYI if we reduce batch size cost/token will increase temporarily. But that's acceptable to restore customer latency.

jamie (eng-oncall): after the scale + fallback shift + batch reduction we're seeing 5xx ~1.2% and p95 ~1.6s. Marking incident as currently mitigated for customers; still monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: PD-94217 status updated: mitigated. No auto-resolve until oncall closes.

sara (support): sending customer note now: "We've mitigated an elevated failure rate for inference. Some requests may have experienced timeouts between 16:42-17:05 PT. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with details."

tess (eng-sre): handoff: jamie — can you take first 30m post-mitigation and then hand to me for the long tail (logs + postmortem)?

jamie (eng-oncall): yep I can own the 30m triage. If things look stable after that I'll hand to tess. tagging noah for logs collection.

noah (infra): collecting model logs and scheduler traces now. Will upload to `s3://redwood-incident-logs/PD-94217/` and link here when done.

jamie (eng-oncall): quick status ping in 15m. If anyone sees a regression ping @here.

tess (eng-sre): noted. I'll start the incident doc skeleton in the incidents wiki and add initial mitigations + timeline.

pagerduty-bot: PD-94217: oncall ownership will rotate to tess (eng-sre) at 1987654615 as jamie hands off.

jamie (eng-oncall): handing off to tess now — summary: scale + fallback + batch-size reduction mitigated customer impact; postmortem needed to look at batching policy + autoscale thresholds. I will paste any remaining logs I find in the incident doc.

tess (eng-sre): taking over. Thanks jamie. I'll coordinate root cause and postmortem. Assigning action items: noah collect logs, jamie write timeline, sara prepare final customer comms.

sara (support): on it — will prepare a post-incident message and follow up with any affected customers showing SLA risk.

incident-bot: PD-94217: incident status 'acknowledged -> mitigated'. Incident thread will remain open for follow-up and RCA.

jamie (eng-oncall): last ping before I step away — no regressions in last 10m. leaving pagerduty note with actions taken.

tess (eng-sre): closing live-paging window; keeping thread open for RCA. Good job team :thumbsup:

noah (infra): uploading logs now — link: https://s3.redwood/example/PD-94217/logs.tar.gz

sara (support): final: CS ticket created for impacted tenants, initial outreach done.

jamie (eng-oncall): thanks all. I'll add a short blameless timeline to the incident doc.

tess (eng-sre): noted — next steps: confirm autoscaler thresholds, revisit batching defaults for high-traffic models, and add a playbook entry for fallback routing.

incident-bot: PD-94217 closed for live response. Please update incident doc and label for RCA.
